summary: Iteration 17 backend tests — admin canonical account refactor and per-card drill-downs. 18/18 pytest cases PASSED (100%) against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Verified: (1) admin-login from a fresh device session remaps user_id to 'admin_altaff' WITHOUT mutating the device-user row, (2) repeat admin-login leaves exactly ONE 'Altaf (Admin)' row and ONE holder of the ALTAF referral code, (3) admin-logout restores the session back to the original device user_id with is_admin=False, (4) repeat login→logout cycles keep a single admin row, (5) new GET /admin/users/{id}/withdrawals|completions|checkins all return lists with admin Bearer and return 401/403 without admin auth, (6) /admin/users/{id}/referrals and /transactions still work, (7) smoke endpoints /admob-settings, /banners, /campaigns, /links, /auth/me, /auth/device all healthy. Direct MongoDB inspection confirms only one document has name='Altaf (Admin)' / email=ADMIN_EMAIL / referral_code='ALTAF' (user_id=admin_altaff).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1711 lines — well above the 700-line threshold; should be split into routers (auth, admin, campaigns, rewards) for maintainability.
auth_admin_login + admin-logout duplicate the cookie-or-bearer token extraction logic (lines 513-516 vs 582-585); extract into a small helper.

admin_user_checkins derives check-in history from transactions where source='checkin' — verify this matches the actual source label used by the check-in endpoint; otherwise the card will silently show empty.

/api/auth/me does not validate admin_session_expires_at against now in this snippet; expiry restoration relies on get_current_user (line 300 path) — good, but worth a dedicated test once a 6h-old session exists.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates ephemeral anonymous device users via POST /api/auth/device (device_id prefix 'TEST_dev_'). No manual seeds inserted. Admin row is the production canonical 'admin_altaff' and was demoted (is_admin=False) at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration17.py for regression. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Canonical admin user_id is 'admin_altaff'. Tests leave the admin demoted (logout at end). To check duplicate-admin migration on startup, you can manually insert a fake 'Altaf (Admin)' row with a different user_id, restart backend, and re-run TestAdminCanonicalAccount — startup migrate_duplicate_admins() should rename/demote it.
rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA (already fixed by main agent): previous code created a new user document each admin login because it upserted by email+role flag without a canonical id. Fix uses a fixed ADMIN_USER_ID='admin_altaff' and only remaps session.user_id, storing the original user_id as session.device_user_id so admin-logout / 6h expiry can restore the device user. Verified end-to-end with /auth/me before & after.
